questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in the following sentence: 'If only I _____ the results of that experiment earlier!'
options: had seen
would see
have seen
saw

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.
If I was you, I would not make that mistake.
If I were you, I would not have made that mistake.
If I was you, I would not have made that mistake.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences demonstrates correct ellipsis?
options: She said she would come, and I said I would go.
She said she would come, and I said I will go.
She said she would come, and I said I am going.
She said she would come, and I said I would go.
questions.answer: She said she would come, and I said I would go.

questions.question: Select the sentence that correctly employs a cleft sentence structure to emphasize the location:
options: It was in London that we first met.
It was London where we first met.
It was in London that we met first.
It was London that we met first.
questions.answer: It was in London that we first met.

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence with a formal register and appropriate inversion?
options: Never had I seen such a beautiful garden.
Never I had seen such a beautiful garden.
Never had seen I such a beautiful garden.
Never seen I such a beautiful garden.
questions.answer: Never had I seen such a beautiful garden.
